pageCache.pageTitle: Fees/Funding - Our Lady's Preparatory School & Nursery - Where Learning is the Greatest Adventure
pageCache.text:
Fees are inclusive of:
Mealtimes: breakfast, morning snack, lunch with pudding, afternoon tea and all drinks are provided.
Off-site swimming (3 years +)
As of September 2026, please see fee details below:
Fees inclusive of 15 hour funding
Fees inclusive of 30 hour funding
Fees inclusive of 15 hour funding
Fees inclusive of 30 hour funding
Extra Sessions - a full day is charged at £109
Sibling discount - we offer a sibling discount of 10% applied to the monthly fees.
Early Years Funding is a government scheme that helps families access funded childcare for young children. Eligible children can receive 30 funded hours from the term after they turn 9 months totalling 1140 funded hours per year.
If your child is not eligible, from the term after they turn 3 years, they will be entitled to 15 funded hours totalling 570 funded hours per year.
At Our Lady’s, funded hours are stretched across the year to enable consistency in our offering and for ease to parents of regular monthly fees.
For more information on the Early Years Funding scheme please visit https://beststartinlife.gov.uk/childcare-early-years-education/
Tax-Free Childcare Scheme
Parents and carers may be able to use the Tax-Free Childcare scheme to help pay for childcare.
Tax-Free Childcare can be used to pay for eligible registered childcare costs. For every £8 paid into a Tax-Free Childcare account, the government adds £2, up to the relevant government limits.
If you are eligible, you can use your Tax-Free Childcare account to pay the nursery directly for eligible childcare sessions. Please ensure that payments are made using the Tax-Free Childcare account and that your child’s school account details are used as provided by the school.
For more information about eligibility and how to apply, please visit the official government website www.gov.uk or contact the school finance manager financemanager@olps.co.uk

pageCache.pageTitle: Moving to School - Our Lady's Preparatory School & Nursery - Where Learning is the Greatest Adventure
pageCache.text:
Our team works closely with families to help prepare children for their exciting school journey by encouraging independence, curiosity, confidence, communication and developing life skills through play-based learning and structured activities. We focus on helping children develop routines, social skills and a love of learning so that they are ready for the new experiences that school will bring.
Should your child join Our Lady’s for their schooling journey, joint playtimes with the current Reception class alongside Early Years assemblies, a joint nativity play and additional transition sessions to name a few, help prepare children for their transition through to the school.

pageCache.pageTitle: Activities & Enrichment - Our Lady's Preparatory School & Nursery - Where Learning is the Greatest Adventure
pageCache.text:
Physical Education:
Developed by our Director of Sport, PE sessions are available for all children across the Nursery from 3 months upwards. Sessions are designed to support their physical development in a fun and engaging way via soft play, obstacle courses, balance exercises and team work, for example, whilst promoting a healthy and active way to learn.
Music:
Music lessons provided by our Director of Music, again across all age groups, are designed to encourage creativity, expression and confidence. Children are submerged into the world of music which supports their language development, coordination, listening skills and develops a joy of music and expressive arts.
Dance:
Dance sessions by an external dance teacher, offers a chance for children to have fun moving their bodies and being active whilst developing balance and rhythm and exploring various ways of moving to music. Children’s imagination and creativity are harnessed through music, simple routines and movement which they also enjoy sharing with families at home.
Forest School:
From 2 years, children have the opportunity to learn and explore in a natural environment with Forest School sessions. Through activities such as den building, nature hunts and creative play using natural materials, children develop confidence, resilience and a love for the outside world. Led by qualified staff, children are encouraged to problem solve and work as part of a team in a safe and stimulating space to manage risks and discover nature through hands-on experiences.
Swimming:
Within the academic year before children start school, children have the opportunity to attend off-site swimming sessions providing a fun and supportive introduction to water confidence and basic swimming skills. Guided by qualified swim teachers and supported by our team, swimming helps children to develop strength, balance and overall physical wellbeing whilst teaching children a valuable life skill. Sessions are designed to be enjoyable and encouraging to build water confidence at their own pace.

pageCache.text:
Alongside our original Trustees he was deeply committed to providing education for the local community. Our School was founded in one of our current buildings, with another added a few years later.
Forty years later, the School and Nursery was extended to allow for expansion, leading to its impressive site on one of the most prestigious roads in Crowthorne.
We are proud of our history and remain true to the legacy and vision of Father Boyle.
